statements.t: As of September 30, 2026, ASIF had approximately $4 billion in available liquidity and operated at 1.24x leverage, or 1.19x net of available cash of approximately $463 million, well below the 2.0x regulatory limit and within our target range.
Looking ahead, we remain confident in ASIF’s ability to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns 22 and believe the Fund is well positioned to capitalize on opportunities in the current environment.
